Class ChatMemoryConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.langchain4j.store.memory.chat.ChatMemoryConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.util.Toggleable
@ConfigurationProperties("langchain4j.chat-memory") public final class ChatMemoryConfiguration extends Object implements io.micronaut.core.util.Toggleable
Configures the default ChatMemoryProvider of the AI services: the chat memory store the conversations are kept in, and how the memory evicts old messages.
Since:
2.4.0

      public void setStore(@Nullable String store)
      Parameters:
      store - The name of the ChatMemoryStore bean the conversations are kept in. Defaults to the persistent chat memory store if there is exactly one (Redis, Neo4j, Cassandra, JDBC...), otherwise the in-memory store.
